backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, access control, and task management with tasks, subtasks, IDs, and permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping specific auth and initialization behaviors to source files and components with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of all frontend files in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens and light/dark mode variables for global theming.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app handling Internet Identity auth, robust auth-error recovery, profile setup flow, and task page routing.
frontend/src/components/Auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button that handles Internet Identity auth state, errors, and clears React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/Auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting new authenticated users to save their name before accessing the app.
frontend/src/components/Auth/SignedOutSc: Landing screen for unauthenticated users showing features and sign‑in button with loading state.
frontend/src/components/Error/AccessDeni: Placeholder file for an access-denied error UI; currently contains no content.
frontend/src/components/Layout/Footer.ts: Footer component showing copyright and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Layout/Header.ts: Renders the app header with branding, dark‑mode toggle, user greeting, avatar, and login button based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/Shared/ConfirmDi: Reusable confirmation dialog with customizable text and loading state for destructive or confirm actions.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/CommandPal: Provides a command palette dialog to trigger actions like creating tasks, searching, and toggling views.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/DueAlertsB: Displays dismissible alerts for overdue and soon‑due tasks based on computed due dates and session storage state.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskBulkAc: Shows bulk‑action controls for selected tasks, enabling complete, archive, or delete operations with confirmation.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskForm.t: Form for creating or editing tasks with validation, date selection, priority, tags, and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskItem.t: Renders a single task row with status toggles, selection, metadata badges, and edit/archive/delete actions.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskKanban: Displays a task as a kanban-style card with priority, due info, and actions for edit, archive, duplicate, and delete.
Renders a multi-column kanban skeleton layout using Skeleton and Card placeholders.
Displays tasks in a four-column kanban layout with filtering by status and scrollable task lists.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskList.t: Shows a list of tasks or an empty-state illustration, with loading handled by a skeleton component.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskListSk: Provides a skeleton loader for task lists with placeholder cards and icons.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskPage.t: Main task management page handling filters, view modes, selection, creation, editing, metrics, and keyboard shortcuts.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskToolba: Toolbar offering search, sorting, and filtering controls for task lists.
Utility functions for filtering, sorting, and computing due-date-related metrics for tasks.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useCreateTask.t: React Query mutation hook for creating tasks and invalidating the tasks query.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useDeleteTask.t: React Query mutation hook for deleting tasks and refreshing the tasks query.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useTasks.ts: Fetches tasks via React Query with periodic refetching and identity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useToggleComple: Mutation hook to toggle a task’s completion status and refresh the task list.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useUpdateTask.t: Mutation hook for updating task details and invalidating cached tasks.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useUpdateTaskSt: Mutation hook for updating a task’s status and refreshing the cached task list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and saves the caller's user profile using the authenticated actor with react‑query.
frontend/src/hooks/useDarkMode.ts: Manages dark mode state using localStorage and applies the theme class to the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading stored identities and handling login/logout via AuthClient.
Registers global keyboard shortcuts for new tasks, search, and command palette while ignoring text inputs.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes with OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
Detects whether an error represents an authorization failure by scanning its message for common keywords.
frontend/src/utils/normalizeBackendError: Converts backend and network errors into concise, user‑friendly messages with special cases for common issues.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read, persist, and clear URL parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, radii, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, constraints, features, and known issues for a Motoko + React task manager, including notes on authentication, UI behavior, and task‑saving bugs.
